business_problem: Cultivating service-oriented relationships is central to BankUnited's core mission. As such, the company wanted to help its employees more effectively surface information from its policy and procedures system, which consists of approximately 400 documents.
solution_summary: Regional bank BankUnited Inc. (BankUnited) strives to deliver accurate, timely answers to its small and medium business (SMB) customers when they reach out with questions. However, employees struggled to quickly find information, which resulted in lengthy call times and inconsistent responses. To solve this problem, BankUnited created a generative artificial intelligence (AI) model using Amazon Bedrock , which helps build and scale generative AI applications. This application can answer policy-related questions almost instantly, helping BankUnited boost efficiency and enhance customer and employee satisfaction. With SAVI, employees can phrase their questions naturally while getting reliable responses.

solution_components.name: Amazon Bedrock
solution_components.role: Runs the foundation model layer for the knowledge search and question-answering workflows.

solution_components.name: Amazon Kendra
solution_components.role: Indexes enterprise content and retrieves source material for the knowledge search and question-answering workflows.

solution_components.name: Claude 2
solution_components.role: Provides a large language model used by the knowledge search and question-answering workflows.

evidence_quotes: To solve this problem, BankUnited created a generative artificial intelligence (AI) model using Amazon Bedrock , which helps build and scale generative AI applications.
So, BankUnited turned to Amazon Web Services (AWS) to build an AI application: SAVI.
"The seamless integration of AWS services streamlined our development process," says Jhon Pereda, AVP BI and analytics manager at BankUnited.
Using Anthropic's Claude 2 model in Amazon Bedrock, BankUnited achieved an accuracy rate of 95 percent and response times of less than 10 seconds.
The bank also adopted Amazon Kendra , an intelligent enterprise search service, to help its employees quickly find information.
"It also reduces the training life cycle of the employees." Empowering its employees has had downstream effects.
